editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 用 HuDex 工作区追踪多类数据中的关系、模式与原始证据。
zh.judgment: 高价值切口是可复核的调查线索；“无偏见”和“无幻觉”不能作为已验证保证。
zh.replaces: 调查与尽调团队手工连接交易、通信和文件，再追溯每项发现。
zh.segment: 调查与高风险数据分析
zh.product: 官网将 HuDex 用于财务交易、通信元数据与调查，并支持从关系结构追到原始片段。无监督及拓扑架构为公司描述，本次未取得独立技术评测或后台。
zh.customer: 调查、威胁检测、知识管理和尽调团队是潜在用户，官网明确列这些用途。具体机构买方与合同仍未确认，需求在更快发现并验证重要关系。
zh.workflow: 用户在工作区接数据、搜索和探索关系，再回到原始证据。关联不能直接当作因果，分析师需核对数据质量、时间与上下文后作判断。
zh.business_model: 公开定价与合同未取得，机构或数据规模合同是商业假设。敏感资料部署、索引和专家复核可能决定成本，不能从处理文件数推断盈利。
zh.traction: 官网有流程与界面展示，但没有取得独立准确率、付费采用或错误对照。实时计数与速度动画可能是演示，不应计入真实使用规模。
zh.moat: 关系建模与可追溯证据可能比普通摘要有价值。搜索、图分析、调查工具与通用模型都是替代，优势需在具体调查任务中比较。
zh.funding_read: 融资支持研究与产品交付，不证明“所有因果关系”已能自动成立。下一里程碑是专业用户复核后的有效发现和可重复项目。
zh.risks: 资料缺失或错误关系可能误导调查，过于自信的结论会放大责任。跨数据源身份匹配与权限也可能形成实施难点。
zh.takeaway: 为每项模式保留到原始证据的路径，并让用户质疑关联。把探索效率与最终结论的确定性分开呈现。
zh.watch_next: 看有效线索、错误关系、人工复核与同类项目复用。独立对照及可解释证据会比架构宣传更能降低采购不确定性。

en.summary: HuDex traces relationships, patterns and original evidence across investigation data.
en.judgment: Reviewable leads are valuable; unbiased and hallucination-free marketing is not an established guarantee.
en.replaces: Manually joining transactions, communications and documents, then tracing findings.
en.product: The site positions HuDex for transactions, communication metadata and investigations, with links from structures to passages. Unsupervised/topological architecture is a company description, not independently evaluated here.
en.customer: Investigation, threat detection, knowledge and diligence teams are stated audiences. Buyers and contracts remain unconfirmed; faster discovery and verification are plausible needs.
en.workflow: Users connect data, search relationships and inspect original evidence. Association is not causation; analysts must review quality, timing and context before concluding.
en.business_model: Public prices and contracts were not obtained. Institutional or data-volume contracts are hypotheses; deployment, indexing and expert review affect cost.
en.traction: Demos exist without independent accuracy, payment or error comparisons. Live counters and speed animations may be illustrative, not actual usage scale.
en.moat: Relationship modeling and provenance could differentiate it from summaries. Search, graphs, investigation tools and general models compete on specific tasks.
en.funding_read: Capital supports research and delivery without proving automatic causal conclusions. Expert-reviewed useful findings and repeat projects are milestones.
en.risks: Missing data or wrong links can misdirect investigations, while confident conclusions magnify responsibility. Cross-source identity and access create implementation work.
en.takeaway: Preserve a path from every pattern to original evidence and allow challenges. Separate exploration efficiency from conclusion certainty.
en.watch_next: Watch useful leads, wrong links, review effort and comparable-project reuse. Independent comparisons and provenance reduce procurement uncertainty more than architecture slogans.
